Shaved bald head with a few healed scalp burn scars. Dark welding goggles pushed onto his forehead; eyes visible. His own RIGHT sideburn, on the VIEWER'S LEFT, is singed very short. Chin and front of jaw are bare and clearly visible, with no chin braid, no full chin beard, no moustache connecting sides, no symmetrical beard. Only the single left sideburn is long and braided. His hands are completely outside this cropped shoulder portrait.

From VIEWER'S LEFT to VIEWER'S RIGHT across the raised finger tips: skin LITTLE, skin RING, skin MIDDLE, brass INDEX; brass THUMB projects diagonally at far right. assets.title: The Human Touch — interior
assets.prompt:
Edit this exact illustration of The Human Touch bar.
